name: STAR JUMPS
introduce:
Start in a squat position with your hands touching your feet. 

Jump up, spread your legs apart and raise your arms overhead to your sides. 

Return to the start position, and do the next rep.

tips.text: This is a good exercise to help lose weight, because it burns calories and fat.
This exercise tones your legs and butt, and it can also get your heart rate up.
